import java.io.InputStreamReader

const val MOD = 998244353

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val n = br.readLine().toInt()
    if (n == 1) {

        return
    }
    val maxN = n
    val fact = arrayOf(1L)
    val invFact = arrayOf(1L)
    for (i in 1..maxN) {
        fact += fact[i - 1] * i % MOD
    }
    invFact += modInv(fact[maxN], MOD)
    for (i in maxN - 1 downTo 0) {
        invFact += invFact[maxN - i] * (maxN - i) % MOD
    }
    invFact.reverse()

    dp[0] = 1
    for (i in 1..n) {
        dp[i] = (dp[i - 1] * (2 * i - 1) % MOD + dp[i - 1]) % MOD
    }

    for (k in 1..n) {
        val c = fact[n] * invFact[k] % MOD * invFact[n - k] % MOD
        val ways = c * dp[k] % MOD
        val term = ways * (n - k) % MOD

    var a = a
    var res = 1L
    var b = mod - 2

    return res
